facts.text: The image is a multi-panel dragon reference sheet with a large cinematic illustration across the top, three full-body turnaround panels in the middle row, and four detail panels in the bottom row.

In the large top panel, a black dragon is shown in side profile facing left with its wings raised and extended, standing on wet dark rock; jagged cliffs, smoke, and glowing orange lava or embers are visible in the background.
The middle row is labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and REAR and shows the same dragon from those three full-body angles against a plain dark background.
The bottom row is labeled HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL, presenting close-up views of the dragon's anatomy.
The dragon has dark charcoal scales with blue-teal iridescent highlights, several long swept-back ivory-colored horns, a spiky dorsal crest, large bat-like wings, and heavy clawed feet.
The HEAD CLOSE panel shows the dragon's face in profile, including overlapping facial scales and an amber-orange eye.
The WING MEMBRANE panel shows a dark wing membrane with radiating structural lines, and the SCALE DETAIL panel is a macro view of overlapping dark scales with blue-teal highlights.

card.summary: A dark fantasy concept and reference sheet for a single black dragon, featuring a large volcanic side-view illustration, front/side/rear turnaround views, and close-up studies of the head, wing membrane, clawed foot, and scales.

subjects.descriptor: Massive black dragon, the single character identity shown across all panels
attributes: quadrupedal body with a long neck and long tail
dark charcoal scales with blue-teal iridescent highlights
several long swept-back ivory-colored horns and a spiky dorsal crest
large bat-like wings with dark membranes
heavy clawed feet with prominent curved claws
pose: top panel: standing in side profile facing left with wings raised and extended
front view: facing the viewer with wings spread symmetrically
side profile: full-body side view facing left with wings partly raised
rear view: seen from behind with wings spread and tail directed toward the viewer
detail panels: close views of the head, wing membrane, foot and claws, and scales

card.environment: The large top panel shows wet black rock, jagged dark cliffs, drifting smoke, and glowing orange lava or embers in a volcanic setting. The turnaround and detail panels use a plain dark charcoal background.
card.lighting: The top panel is low-key and moody with smoky backlight and warm lava/ember glow; the turnaround and detail panels use soft neutral lighting that reveals scale and wing texture.
card.framing: Multi-panel concept sheet: a large cinematic side-view illustration at top, three full-body turnaround views in the middle, and four detail close-ups at bottom.
card.style: Dark fantasy creature concept art with high-detail photorealistic rendering
card.characterisation: A single original dragon design with swept-back horns, a spiked crest, bat-like wings, a long tail, and clawed feet; its appearance is consistent across all views.
card.camera: Mixed framings: wide side-profile view, orthographic-style full-body views, and macro detail views

limitations: As a still reference sheet, it cannot establish motion, sound, dialogue, or behavior over time.
The dragon's absolute size and physical material are not determinable from the image.
